About Me

Game day starts
long before puck drop.

I grew up playing competitive soccer and hockey, and sport has been my passion for as long as I can remember. Studying marketing at the Schulich School of Business showed me how to turn that passion into a career, and I fell in love with the business side of the game: ticketing and marketing.

Today I work where the numbers meet the fans: pricing, presales and revenue targets on one side, and promo days, partnerships and community programs on the other.

I care about making sport accessible to everyone. At the Toronto Arrows, I built a program that brought more than 2,300 underserved youth to live games, and at Curling Canada, our youth initiatives have driven over 16,000 tickets. Outside of work, I coach youth soccer and help make sport safer through PREVNet and the Coaching Association of Canada's Support Through Sport program.

I'm looking to bring that mix of revenue focus and fan-first thinking to a professional team.
